podcast.title: 1980s Career
podcast.body: Throughout much of the 1980s, Chris Butler focused his career on working as a record producer and producing various cable TV shows, before returning to performing as a solo artist in the mid-1990s. "Chris spent much of the 1980s as a record producer and producing a bunch of cable TV shows."

podcast.title: Kent State University Experience
podcast.body: Originally from Ohio, Chris Butler attended Kent State University and was among the students present when the National Guard fired upon protesters on May 4th, 1970. This event famously inspired the Crosby, Stills, Nash & Young song "Ohio." "He was actually in the group of students that was fired upon by the National Guard on May 4th of 1970."

podcast.title: Square Pegs Theme Song
podcast.body: Chris Butler wrote the theme song for the CBS comedy "Square Pegs," which aired around 1981 and featured a very young Sarah Jessica Parker. "At around the same time, he wrote the theme song for the CBS comedy called Square Pigs, which started a very young Sarah Jessica Parker."
